name: caption
title: Karaoke caption
description: Word-timed captions from a words JSON: the voice-over's words grouped into short lines, each line shown while it is spoken, the current word lit in the highlight color. Pass words as "$words:<spine-id>" so they follow the VO through every trim, or inline as [{w, s, e}] in seconds on the overlay's clock.

words.description: "$words:<spine-id>" (that spine item's words, timed on this overlay's clock), or a list of {w, s, e}: the word and its start and end in seconds from the overlay's start.

words_per_line.description: At most this many words on a line.

gap.description: A pause longer than this many seconds starts a new line.

hold.description: Seconds a line stays up after its last word ends (when no new line starts).

y.description: Vertical center of the line, design pixels.

max_width.description: A long line wraps at spaces beyond this width.

text.expr: (() => { const W = Array.isArray(props.words) ? props.words : []; const L = []; let c = []; for (const w of W) { if (c.length && (c.length >= props.words_per_line || w.s - c[c.length - 1].e > props.gap)) { L.push(c); c = []; } c.push(w); } if (c.length) L.push(c); let k = -1; for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { if (L[i][0].s <= t + 0.04) k = i; } if (k < 0) return ''; const line = L[k]; if (t > line[line.length - 1].e + props.hold) return ''; return line.map((w) => String(w.w).trim()).join(' '); })()

words.expr: (() => { const W = Array.isArray(props.words) ? props.words : []; const L = []; let c = []; for (const w of W) { if (c.length && (c.length >= props.words_per_line || w.s - c[c.length - 1].e > props.gap)) { L.push(c); c = []; } c.push(w); } if (c.length) L.push(c); let k = -1; for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { if (L[i][0].s <= t + 0.04) k = i; } if (k < 0) return [-1, -1]; const line = L[k]; let j = -1; for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) { if (line[i].s <= t + 0.04) j = i; } return j < 0 || t > line[j].e + 0.25 && j === line.length - 1 ? [-1, -1] : [j, j + 1]; })()
